in_sanskrit.name: Ekayani
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ekam (One) + Yani (One-sided, Unilateral, Single-minded, One-pointed, One-footed)

in_marathi.name: Ekayani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekayani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekayani is the Sanskrit name for the Goddess of the Sun, who is often depicted riding a chariot drawn by seven horses. The name 'Ek' means 'one' and 'ayani' means 'rider', indicating that she is the one who rides the sun across the sky.
